utv.uk.title: Grantchester
utv.uk.description: Crime drama. Carson's Circus has rolled into town and Will, Geordie and the rest of the Grantchester family are making the trip to it - they delight in watching mind-bending illusions and death-defying stunts, but the very next morning dawns with Errol Macabre, one of the circus performers, being found dead having been shot with a crossbow that was used in a magic trick. Was this a tragic accident caused by a malfunctioning prop? When Geordie sees that the crossbow has been tampered with, he realises this was no such thing and that someone wanted Errol dead - with the circus closed and the rest of the performers having alibis for the time of the murder, who could have possibly done this. utv.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure - The Hamptons
utv.uk.description: The East Coast stretch of James's American adventure takes him to The Hamptons - known as being the playground of wealthy New Yorkers, the area has a rich farming history. James taps into this by visiting Amber Waves Farm, where he borrows their outdoor pizza oven to cook for the farmers using seasonal local produce - as well as being famous for the beautiful Montauk Point Lighthouse, The Hamptons has an abundance of great seafood restaurants, so James visits The Dock House in Sag Harbor to try one of the best seafood chowders around. Finally, knowing that the area is famous for lobster, James joins a fishing boat and cooks a deceptively easy and impressive lobster speciality. (Documentary) - 2018

utv.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure - Philadelphia
utv.uk.description: James's American adventure continues with a visit to Philadelphia - The City of Brotherly Love is the perfect backdrop for his foodie adventure, with Reading Terminal Market providing all manner of ingredients for both of his cooks. The market even has its own kitchen, so it's not a problem if James forgets an ingredient - James then ditches the car to take a tour of the city's famous murals, but vehicles with more power await... Philadelphia is home to one of the most impressive car collections in the world - as a result, James gets a spin in a very special car. Philadelphia is also host to an upcoming movement of vegan eating - Charlie Was A Sinner is at the forefront of this, and James's visit allows us to see what makes a restaurant like this so popular. (Documentary) - 2018

utv.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
utv.uk.description: Agronomist Ben arrives to check on the farm's oats and maize, but before getting down to business, Max has an important call to make to Spider-Man. Once his superhero duties are complete, attention turns to the crops and how they are progressing. Meanwhile, Liz and Kelvin enjoy an unusual day date with a visit to local beekeepers. Hoping to bring bees to the farm, they discover what it takes to care for a colony and learn there is plenty to consider before taking the plunge. There is also a farewell as bull Ezra's time on the farm comes to an end. Kelvin takes him to market in the hope of finding him a new home, marking another change among the farm's animals. Then it is all hands on deck for the Royal Cheshire Show. Liz and Kelvin pack enough farm produce to fill a huge marquee, along with the butcher's fridge to keep their Milo sausages chilled. With everything ready, they step into the world of trading and face a busy day behind the counter. (Reality) - 2023

utv.uk.title: Millionaire Hot Seat - Tue 6th Jan 7.30pm
utv.uk.description: Jeremy Clarkson hosts the exciting and fast-paced quiz where each episode sees six hopefuls compete for a one-million-pound prize - however, only one player can take their place in the Hot Seat at a time and answer multiple-choice questions to work their way up the Money Ladder. Unlike classic Millionaire, each question is against the clock and there is no room for indecision - if a player answers correctly, they remain in the Hot Seat and continue up the Money Ladder, but if they get a question wrong, they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place. Each player is given one Pass - a chance to pass the question on to the next player - but in doing so forfeit their place in the Hot Seat and risk not making it back there later on. Only one player will have a chance to win the top prize remaining on the ladder, and the player taking on that question must answer it correctly to take home the cash. (Reality) - 2026

utv.uk.description: This episode features two women searching for siblings - the first has been hoping to find her brother ever since learning of the enormous burden of grief her mother carried after giving him up. Tracey Boyle had children of her own before she learned of her brother's existence - after a stay in hospital following a breakdown, her mother finally confided in Tracey the enormous weight of grief she carried ever since her first-born son was prised from her hands at the age of 16 and placed for adoption. Tracey is determined to find him and let him know he was wanted - in our second story, a woman who had a strange sense she had a sister out there during her own adoption finally gets confirmation of her intuition. Liz Allward was adopted as a baby, but she always had an uncanny feeling that she had a biological sister somewhere out there and has longed to meet her from the moment she found out she was right. itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 Skye (30min) James is joined by fellow chef Tony Singh for a tour of the Isle of Skye and is inspired by the amazing local seafood to cook up a tasty dish using monkfish and mussels. The pair then take a boat trip, during which they spot dozens of dolphins, and James cooks up a fresh lobster and langoustine dish with an added Scottish twist.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E17 Salem The chef explores Salem, Massachusetts, which was made famous by the witch trials of 1692. He visits a unique spice shop, where he picks up some ingredients to cook with, and also meets a seafood artist and makes a stop at Turner's, a family-run seafood business.

itv1anglia.uk.description: S8 E28 Eric Idle and La Voix join Alan for a chat, while there is a catch-up with the puppy school to see how the class of '26 is getting on. Chefs Richard Corrigan and Asma Khan join James in the kitchen.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Nations Championship : Italy v South Africa
itv1anglia.uk.description: Italy v South Africa (Kick-off 11.40am). Jill Douglas presents all the action from both teams' opening match of the Northern Hemsiphere Series, held at Allianz Stadium in Turin. World champions South Africa currently sit top of the Southern Hemisphere table with three wins from three, while Italy are bottom of the Northern table after three defeats, but will hope they can be competitive in front of their own fans. With analysis from John Barclay and Greig Laidlaw, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Tom Shanklin.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Nations Championship : Scotland v New Zealand
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E21 Scotland v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Jill Douglas presents all the action from the match at Scottish Gas Murrayfield. Scotland impressed in the Southern Hemisphere Series, winning two of their three matches, but they face a tough test against the All Blacks, who have won all of their contests in the competition so far. With analysis from John Barclay, Greig Laidlaw and Sean Fitzpatrick, commentary by Miles Harrison and Johnnie Beattie, and reports from Gabriel Clarke.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Nations Championship : Wales v Japan
itv1anglia.uk.description: Wales v Japan (Kick-off 4.40pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the match at Principality Stadium. Both teams won just one match of three in the Southern Hemisphere series and will be looking to impress this evening. The last time the nations met was in Wales' 2025 tour of Japan, when the teams won one match apiece. With analysis from Dan Biggar and Sam Warburton, and commentary by Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams and Jamie Roberts.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Nations Championship : France v Fiji
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E23 France v Fiji (Kick-off 8.10pm). Lauren Salter presents all the action from the match at Groupama Stadium in Lyon. This is the first game of the Northern Hemisphere series for both teams, and France narrowly lost to New Zealand in their first contest of the Southern Series, before recording victories over Australia and Japan. They will expect to continue their winning run against the Fijians, who have lost all three of their matches so far against Wales, England and Scotland. With analysis from Dan Biggar and Jamie Roberts, and commentary by Johnnie Hammond and Ben Kayser.

Then, he pays a visit to seafood restaurant The Dock House in Sag Harbour, where he samples their famous chowder.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E19 Philadelphia James heads to Philadelphia, where Reading Terminal Market provides all manner of ingredients for his dishes. James then takes a tour of the city's famous murals, sees one of the most impressive car collections in the world and hears about the rise of vegan eating restaurants in the city.

itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E1 Flavour Foundations: Bahamian Classics Chef Ainsley Harriott explores the vibrant flavours, local producers, markets and unique dishes of the island nation located in the Atlantic Ocean. He kicks off his island adventures with the comfort foods at the heart of Bahamian cooking, from 'chicken in da bag' at Bamboo Shack to learning to put his peas before his rice with chef Tevin Kemp. Then he wraps things up in his beachside kitchen with prawn and coconut fritters served with a pickled coconut slaw.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Nations Championship : England v Australia
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E24 England v Australia (Kick-off 3.10pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' opening match in the Northern Hemisphere Series, held at Allianz Stadium Twickenham. England bounced back from a defeat at the hands of South Africa in the Southern Series with victories over Fiji and Argentina. Australia comfortably claimed their first win of the series against Italy after losses to Ireland and France. With analysis from Ugo Monye and George Gregan, pitchside reports by Topsy Ojo, and commentary from Nick Mullins, David Flatman and Ben Kay.

Each question is against the clock and if a player gets one wrong they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Jurassic World: Dominion
itv1anglia.uk.description: Sci-fi adventure sequel starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard, featuring Laura Dern, Sam Neill and Jeff Goldblum. Four years after the destruction of Isla Nublar, dinosaurs are roaming the earth once more. When dino-protectors Owen Grady and Claire Dearing discover that biogenetics company BioSyn is collecting dinosaurs for sinister research, they team up with the experts who survived the dangers of the original Jurassic Park.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Long Lost Family
itv1anglia.uk.description: S14 E4 Episode Four Davina McCall and Nicky Campbell present the stories of two women searching for siblings. itvcentral.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Scotland v New Zealand

(Rugby)

itvcentral.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Wales v Japan

Every point will be crucial ahead of two tough fixtures against New Zealand and Australia, which will close out the Northern Series for Wales. (Rugby)

itvgranada.uk.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands - Skye
itvgranada.uk.description: James takes a magical trip to the stunning Isle of Skye, where he's joined by top chef and ultimate Scotsman Tony Singh. Tony visits a local bakery which doubles as an art gallery and learns to make the local oatcakes. James is inspired by the amazing local seafood and cooks up a tasty dish using plaice and lovage. Their day comes to a perfect end aboard a boat, where they spot dozens of dolphins, and James cooks up a fresh lobster and langoustine dish with an added Scottish twist. (Cookery, Entertainment, Travel) - 2020

itvgranada.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure - Salem
itvgranada.uk.description: James is in Salem on the East Coast of the USA. This town was made famous by the witch trials of 1692, and things get spooky as James is visiting on the approach to Hallo'ween! We hear from Salem's official witch Laurie Cabot. Meanwhile, James meets a love clairvoyant and her dogs! Salem isn't just about witchcraft, James visits a unique spice shop and picks up some spices to cook with. (Cookery, Entertainment, Travel) - 2018

itvgranada.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
itvgranada.uk.description: The legendary Eric Idle joins Alan, and La Voix makes her Love Your Weekend debut. We catch up with our puppy school to see how the class of '26 is getting on, herb grower Jekka McVicar has potions and spells this Halloween weekend, and we are celebrating the joy of Monty Python in today's Best of British, in honour of Eric Idle. (Home improvement, House/garden, Interview) - 2026

itvgranada.uk.title: ITV News
itvgranada.uk.description: The latest national and international news.

itvgranada.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
itvgranada.uk.description: On Remembrance weekend, James cooks cured trout and popcorn prawns with ponzu tuna for Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen who talks about his work with the Royal British Legion as well as his career in design and TV. Chefs Richard Corrigan and Asma Khan join James in the kitchen.

itvgranada.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Italy v South Africa
itvgranada.uk.description: Jill Douglas presents live coverage of the Nations Championship as Italy face South Africa at the Allianz Stadium in Turin. Rassie Erasmus' side tops the southern hemisphere table after winning all three of their fixtures during the summer and the world champions will be looking to continue their perfect record in the competition. They take on an Italy side that is at the bottom of the northern hemisphere table after losing all three of their Nations Championship matches. (Rugby)

itvgranada.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Scotland v New Zealand
itvgranada.uk.description: Jill Douglas presents live coverage of the Nations Championship as Scotland face New Zealand at Murrayfield. Scotland have never beaten New Zealand, it's a run that goes back 121 years and stretches 33 matches. Last year, Gregor Townsend's side recovered from 17-0 down at half time to draw level with the All Blacks but a late try from Damian McKenzie helped maintain New Zealand's long unbeaten run against Scotland. (Rugby)

itvgranada.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Wales v Japan
itvgranada.uk.description: Lauren Salter is joined by guests Dan Biggar and Sam Warburton for live rugby from round four of the Nations Championship as Wales host Japan at the Principality Stadium. Wales are looking to make a winning start against Eddie Jones' Japan side, who they beat by a single point in Cardiff a year ago. Every point will be crucial ahead of two tough fixtures against New Zealand and Australia, which will close out the Northern Series for Wales. (Rugby)

(Rugby)

itvgranada.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
itvgranada.uk.description: Joining Alan Titchmarsh at Manor Farm this Remembrance Sunday are racing hero Billy Monger and Gavin and Stacey's Laura Aikman. Plus, a celebration of the role of donkeys during the world wars, and the D-Day Darlings perform a Vera Lynn classic. Then, original emergency service vehicles used to help wounded soldiers during the war years make their way onto the show. (Home improvement, House/garden, Interview) - 2026

itvgranada.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
itvgranada.uk.description: Agronomist Ben arrives to check on the farm's oats and maize, but before getting down to business, Max has an important call to make to Spider-Man. Once his superhero duties are complete, attention turns to the crops and how they are progressing. Meanwhile, Liz and Kelvin enjoy an unusual day date with a visit to local beekeepers. Hoping to bring bees to the farm, they discover what it takes to care for a colony and learn there is plenty to consider before taking the plunge. (Documentary, Animals, Outdoors) - 2026

itvgranada.uk.title: Cooking with the Stars
itvgranada.uk.description: Emma Willis and Tom Allen host as four stars - Joey Essex, JB Gill, Caroline Quentin and Harry Akines-Aryeetey - take on each other in the first-ever four-way cooking battle. They'll have to produce stand-out dishes from a recipe they've never seen before in just 30 minutes. The two stars who impress the most go straight through to the quarter-finals, and the losing stars will have to impress the world-class chefs and cook again in the cook-off - where one will leave the competition. (Cookery, Entertainment, Reality) - 2026

itvgranada.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: England v Australia
itvgranada.uk.description: England resume their Nations Championship campaign as they entertain Australia at the Allianz Stadium, Twickenham. The Wallabies pulled off a sensational 42-38 win over South Africa in Perth back in September. (Rugby)

itvtynetees.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Italy v South Africa
itvtynetees.uk.description: Jill Douglas presents live coverage of the Nations Championship as Italy face South Africa at the Allianz Stadium in Turin. Rassie Erasmus' side tops the southern hemisphere table after winning all three of their fixtures during the summer and the world champions will be looking to continue their perfect record in the competition. They take on an Italy side that is at the bottom of the northern hemisphere table after losing all three of their Nations Championship matches. (Rugby)

itvtynetees.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Scotland v New Zealand
itvtynetees.uk.description: Jill Douglas presents live coverage of the Nations Championship as Scotland face New Zealand at Murrayfield. Scotland have never beaten New Zealand, it's a run that goes back 121 years and stretches 33 matches. Last year, Gregor Townsend's side recovered from 17-0 down at half time to draw level with the All Blacks but a late try from Damian McKenzie helped maintain New Zealand's long unbeaten run against Scotland. (Rugby)

itvtynetees.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: Wales v Japan
itvtynetees.uk.description: Lauren Salter is joined by guests Dan Biggar and Sam Warburton for live rugby from round four of the Nations Championship as Wales host Japan at the Principality Stadium. Wales are looking to make a winning start against Eddie Jones' Japan side, who they beat by a single point in Cardiff a year ago. Every point will be crucial ahead of two tough fixtures against New Zealand and Australia, which will close out the Northern Series for Wales. (Rugby)

itvwales.uk.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands - Skye
itvwales.uk.description: James takes a magical trip to the stunning Isle of Skye, where he's joined by top chef and ultimate Scotsman Tony Singh. stvnorth.uk.description: S8 E29 Joining Alan at Manor Farm this Remembrance Sunday are former racing driver Billy Monger and actress Laura Aikman. Plus, a celebration of the role of donkeys during the world wars, and the D-Day Darlings perform a Vera Lynn classic.

stvnorth.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
stvnorth.uk.description: S5 E6 Agronomist Ben Clare arrives to check on the farm's oats and maize, while Liz and Kelvin enjoy an unusual date with a visit to local beekeepers. There is also a farewell as bull Ezra's time on the farm comes to an end and Kelvin takes him to market in the hope of finding him a new home.

stvnorth.uk.title: Talking Royals
stvnorth.uk.description: S2 E5 A weekly round-up of royal news, with expert analysis from ITV News' royal editor Chris Ship and expert Lizzie Robinson, and guests.

stvnorth.uk.title: Cooking with the Stars
stvnorth.uk.description: S6 E5 Emma Willis and Tom Allen host as Joey Essex, JB Gill, Caroline Quentin and Harry Aikines-Aryeetey take on each other in a four-way cooking battle. They'll produce dishes from a recipe they've never seen before in just 30 minutes. The two celebrities who impress the most go through to the quarter finals, and the losing stars will have to impress world class chefs and cook again in the final few minutes, before one leaves the competition.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV News and Weather
stvnorth.uk.description: E82 08/11/2026 - 1 Round-up of the latest headlines.

stvnorth.uk.title: Ainsley's Taste of the Bahamas
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E1 Flavour Foundations: Bahamian Classics Chef Ainsley Harriott explores the vibrant flavours, local producers, markets and unique dishes of the island nation located in the Atlantic Ocean. He kicks off his island adventures with the comfort foods at the heart of Bahamian cooking, from 'chicken in da bag' at Bamboo Shack to learning to put his peas before his rice with chef Tevin Kemp. Then he wraps things up in his beachside kitchen with prawn and coconut fritters served with a pickled coconut slaw.

stvnorth.uk.title: Nations Championship : England v Australia
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E24 England v Australia (Kick-off 3.10pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' opening match in the Northern Hemisphere Series, held at Allianz Stadium Twickenham. England bounced back from a defeat at the hands of South Africa in the Southern Series with victories over Fiji and Argentina. Australia comfortably claimed their first win of the series against Italy after losses to Ireland and France. With analysis from Ugo Monye and George Gregan, pitchside reports by Topsy Ojo, and commentary from Nick Mullins, David Flatman and Ben Kay.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV News and Weather
stvnorth.uk.description: S11 E87 08/11/2026 - 2 Round-up of the latest headlines.

stvnorth.uk.title: Millionaire Hot Seat
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E1 Jeremy Clarkson hosts a quiz in which six hopefuls compete for £1 million, with only one player at a time able to take a place in the Hot Seat and answer multiple-choice questions to work the way up the Money Ladder. Each question is against the clock and if a player gets one wrong they are eliminated, the Top Prize drops down, and the next player takes their place.

stvnorth.uk.title: Jurassic World: Dominion
stvnorth.uk.description: Sci-fi adventure sequel starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard, featuring Laura Dern, Sam Neill and Jeff Goldblum. Four years after the destruction of Isla Nublar, dinosaurs are roaming the earth once more. When dino-protectors Owen Grady and Claire Dearing discover that biogenetics company BioSyn is collecting dinosaurs for sinister research, they team up with the experts who survived the dangers of the original Jurassic Park.

stvnorth.uk.title: Adultery
stvnorth.uk.description: S1 E5 Jess and Ollie's bad behaviour causes Hannah to reveal her painful past, while Beth decides to confront hers. The weight of their choice looms over Beth and Tom. Drama, starring Dominic Cooper and Romola Garai.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV News and Weather
stvnorth.uk.description: E89 08/11/2026 - 3 Round-up of the latest headlines.

stvnorth.uk.title: Long Lost Family
stvnorth.uk.description: S14 E4 Episode Four Davina McCall and Nicky Campbell present the stories of two women searching for siblings. Tracey Boyle had children of her own before she learned of her brother's existence when her mother finally confided in her that her first-born son was prised from her hands at the age of 16. Liz Allward was adopted as a baby but always had a feeling that she had a biological sister and has longed to meet her since being proved right.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Body Double (1984)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Voyeuristic thriller about an unemployed actor who spies on the sexual antics of a beautiful woman in a neighbouring apartment - only to witness her brutal murder. He teams up with a porn star to unravel the mystery. (Thriller) - 1984

talkingpictures.uk.title: Tomorrow (1972)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Based on a story by William Faulkner. A lonely handyman takes a protective interest in an abandoned pregnant woman. (Drama) - 1972

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Most Dangerous Game (1932)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A psychopathic hunter goes after the most dangerous game of all on a desolate island. He wants to hunt and kill humans for sport. His intended victims are the survivors of a shipwreck, which the hunter arranged specifically for the occasion. (Horror) - 1932

talkingpictures.uk.title: Cinebox Memories
talkingpictures.uk.description: Join English pop group The Mudlarks as they perform the charming hit song La De Da. (Documentary) - 2025

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Vise - Ring of Greed
talkingpictures.uk.description: Ring of Greed. 1955. Stars Megs Jenkins, Clifford Evans & Betty Anne Davis. Margaret and Frank fell in love at first sight but will Margaret manage to escape from a fate that is unknown to her. (Drama, Crime) - 1955

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - Shoot a Crooked Arrow
talkingpictures.uk.description: In the caped crusader's second season opener, The Archer, a medieval crook modelled after Robin Hood, escapes from the police headquarters in a van from The Trojan Hearse Company, driven by maid Marilyn. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Crime) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - Walk the Straight and Narrow
talkingpictures.uk.description: Just as the dynamic duo are about to be impaled, they activate the Batsprings cleverly hidden in their boots, which catapult them up, up, and away, out of harm's way. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Crime) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: Minesweeper (1943)
talkingpictures.uk.description: An Annapolis graduate discharged for gambling rejoins the Navy and helps uncover a new type of Japanese mine. (War) - 1943

talkingpictures.uk.title: Talk About Jacqueline (1942)
talkingpictures.uk.description: While yachting and flirting on the Riviera, a woman with a past meets a shy, retiring young researcher from the Far East and, against her better judgment, marries him. He runs across some scandalous gossip touching her past. (Romantic comedy) - 1942

talkingpictures.uk.title: Radio London 1967
talkingpictures.uk.description: A short promo film shot on board the Radio London pirate radio ship in summer 1967, shortly before the station's closure. DJs seen include John Peel, Mark Roman, Pete Drummond and Willie Walker. (Documentary, Special) - 2026

talkingpictures.uk.title: Legend of the Hidden City
talkingpictures.uk.description: Stars Brendan Pollecutt, Fezile Mpela & Robert Finlayson. Morgan plans to attack 'The Source'. Meanwhile, Ram declares war on Queen Kama and her people. (Action, Adventure) - 2026

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Adventures of William Tell - The Trap
talkingpictures.uk.description: By using a traitor planted in Tell's camp, Gessler plans to smash the resistance movement in one swoop. (Adventure, Archery) - 1959

talkingpictures.uk.title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans - La Salle's Treasure
talkingpictures.uk.description: Fortune hunters seek a treasure rumored to have belonged to the French explorer La Salle. (Action, Adventure, Western) - 1957

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Lone Ranger - Rustler's Hideout
talkingpictures.uk.description: Outlaws demand their leader's release in return for a boy's life. (Adventure, Western) - 1949

talkingpictures.uk.title: Supercar - Hostage
talkingpictures.uk.description: The adventures of the crew of Supercar, an amazing land, sea, and air vehicle, based at a secret laboratory in the Nevada Desert in 1961. (Fantasy, Science fiction, Children) - 1961

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood - Food for Thought
talkingpictures.uk.description: Robin Hood poses as a French chef to prepare a feast when Count Oliver steals the villagers' food. (Action, Adventure) - 1957

talkingpictures.uk.title: Biggles: Adventures in Time (1986)
talkingpictures.uk.description: James "Biggles" Bigglesworth and 1980s Jim Ferguson discover they have the ability to travel through time to each other's eras. Determined to stop the Germans changing the outcome of World War One, the duo attempt to destroy a German super weapon. (Science fiction) - 1986

talkingpictures.uk.title: Damn the Defiant! (1962)
talkingpictures.uk.description: An 18th-century ship captain's crew are driven to mutiny by the viciousness of one of the officers, despite the dangers of invasion by the French. (Historical drama) - 1962

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Scales of Justice - Personal and Confidential
talkingpictures.uk.description: A thirteen part series of featurettes from British cinema. (Drama, Crime) - 1965

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Quatermass Xperiment (1955)
talkingpictures.uk.description: An astronaut returns to Earth after an experimental space flight afflicted by a strange fungus that transforms him into a murderous monster. After bullets and bombs fail to stop the creature, brilliant scientist Professor Quatermass becomes mankind's last hope of survival. (Science fiction) - 1955

talkingpictures.uk.title: Tell Me Another - How They Started in Showbusiness
talkingpictures.uk.description: Dick Hills tells personal anecdotes. (Entertainment, Interview) - 1978

talkingpictures.uk.title: Dick Turpin - The Godmother
talkingpictures.uk.description: Glutton's Godmother, the Dutches of Durham is coming for a visit. Turpin and Swiftnick are robbing the Gooches just when Glutton's men come to fetch his pretend wife, and Dick ends up in drag. (Action, Adventure, Biography, Entertainment) - 1980

talkingpictures.uk.title: Maigret - The Golden Fleece
talkingpictures.uk.description: Parisian detective chief superintendent Maigret investigates murder cases. (Crime drama) - 1961

talkingpictures.uk.title: Lillie - The Jersey Lillie
talkingpictures.uk.description: Lillie is a sensational success at her first social event in London, and soon the artists, writers and leaders of fashionable society are captivated by her - including one Oscar Wilde. Before long she has become a 'Professional Beauty', with pictures of her on magazines and available for sale in shops. (Drama, History) - 1978

talkingpictures.uk.title: Prudence and the Pill (1968)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Five couples attempt to avoid pregnancy by using contraceptive pills, but none of them are prepared to openly admit this is what they want. As a result of a series of mishaps involving them all, the pills are swapped for aspirin. (Comedy) - 1968

talkingpictures.uk.title: Eurotrash
talkingpictures.uk.description: Hosted by Antoine de Caunes and special guests, Eurotrash is the iconic late-night magazine show exploring Europe's most unconventional stories, eccentric personalities and pop culture moments. Blending irreverent humour with distinctive European flair, each 30-minute episode delivers an entertaining and unpredictable journey across the continent.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Around the World in 80 Raves
talkingpictures.uk.description: It's the end of the road for our Leicester lads and lasses. They've travelled over 8,000 miles across America and this is the fifth and final instalment of their travel exploits.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Confessions of a Window Cleaner (1974)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A young window cleaner discovers that his lady customers often require a little extra polishing. Based on Timothy Leary's novel. (Comedy) - 1974

talkingpictures.uk.title: Rentadick (1972)
talkingpictures.uk.description: The incompetent detectives of Rentadick, Inc. track thieves of an experimental nerve gas that paralyses from the waist down. (Comedy) - 1972

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Girl on the Pier (1953)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Rivalry between a Brighton crooner who has done time and his partner in crime, who is now being blackmailed. (Drama) - 1953

talkingpictures.uk.title: One Step Beyond - Make Me Not A Witch
talkingpictures.uk.description: A farm girl's parents are terrified when their daughter reveals that she can read minds. But a priest knows that her gifts can save twoyoung lives.Sun, Mar 03, 2024. (Science fiction, Anthology) - 2024

talkingpictures.uk.title: Enter the Lone Ranger (1949)
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Lone Ranger and Tonto begin their quest for justice. (Western) - 1949

talkingpictures.uk.title: What's on TPTV with Noel
talkingpictures.uk.description: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout November. (Entertainment, History, Talk) - 2026

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Super Secret Service (1953)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Directed by Charles W. Green. Stars Peter Sellers, Graham Stark, Dick Emery & Raymond Francis. Brilliantly bizarre comedy short about the workings of the 'Super Secret Service'. (Comedy) - 1953

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Paratrooper (1954)
talkingpictures.uk.description: An ex-US army officer with a mysterious past joins the British army as a paratrooper. Despite his obvious leadership skills, the man refuses to take a high rank. However, when a raid in North Africa goes disastrously wrong, he finds himself forced to take command. (War) - 1954

talkingpictures.uk.title: Lest We Forget
talkingpictures.uk.description: To commemorate the end of WWI, war historian Alan Forbes visits the battlefields and memorials of Flanders and the Somme. (Documentary, War) - 2021

talkingpictures.uk.title: We Will Remember Them
talkingpictures.uk.description: We join the nation in paying tribute to the fallen. We honour our heroes with The Last Post.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Carve Her Name With Pride (1958)
talkingpictures.uk.description: True story of young English war-widow Violette Szabo, who became a secret agent in occupied France during World War II. Exposed to the brutality of the Gestapo and the degradation of the concentration camps, she found herself facing a continual struggle for survival, but through sheer courage and grim determination, she eventually became the first woman to be awarded the George Cross. (Biography / Historical drama) - 1958

talkingpictures.uk.title: Review No.1 29th Year (The Royal British Legion)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Royal British Legion.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Nine Men (1943)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A group of British soldiers is attacked from the air while travelling across the desolate wastes of World War II Libya. (Adventure) - 1943

talkingpictures.uk.title: That's My Boy - Hello Young Mothers
talkingpictures.uk.description: Ida finds out that a charity is planning to open a home for unmarried mothers. Mrs. Cross petitions against it. (Sitcom) - 1985

talkingpictures.uk.title: For the Love of Ada - The Baby
talkingpictures.uk.description: As Ruth appears to be going into labour, Ada and Walter are slightly troubled in their new home by the presence of a ghost. (Sitcom) - 1971

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Man From U.N.C.L.E - The Deadly Goddess Affair
talkingpictures.uk.description: Solo faces death and Illya faces possible matrimony as they try to steal the cash THRUSH wants to use to take over Africa. (Crime drama) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Footage Detectives
talkingpictures.uk.description: Mike and Noel are joined by Isla St Clair where she shares footage and opens up about childhood memories and her career. And there's a reel from one of the first TV stations to transmit from home. (Mystery, Art, History) - 2026

talkingpictures.uk.title: Enemy at the Door - Jerrybag
talkingpictures.uk.description: The locals turn on an island girl who finds romance with a German soldier and subsequently falls pregnant. (Drama, War) - 1978

talkingpictures.uk.title: My Cousin Rachel (1952)
talkingpictures.uk.description: B&W. The heir to a considerable fortune attempts to find out if the woman he loves is really a murderer. (Thriller) - 1952

talkingpictures.uk.title: Look at Life - The Sky's The Limit
talkingpictures.uk.description: A look at the aerobatics of the RAF and the civil flyers. (Documentary, Community, History) - 1963

talkingpictures.uk.title: Fox - If It's Good Enough for New Orleans It's Good Enough for Clapham
talkingpictures.uk.description: Drama with Ray Winstone following Billy Fox, an outwardly retired Covent Garden market porter living in Clapham who is also involved in crime in London's East End. (Crime drama, Drama) - 1980

talkingpictures.uk.title: Runaway Train (1985)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Philosophical action thriller about two escaped prisoners who hide on board a train speeding through Alaska. The driver suffers a fatal heart attack and the train races out of control through the icy wilderness. With the railroad signalmen unable to stop it and a vindictive prison warden desperately pursuing them by helicopter, the train's passengers look set to face disaster. Based on a screenplay by Akira Kurosawa. (Action) - 1985

together.uk.title: Escort Girls (1974)
together.uk.description: It's Christmas Eve in London and various lonely men and women turn to male and female escorts for company. (Drama / Romance) - 1974

together.uk.title: Permissive
together.uk.description: Suzy arrives in London with nowhere to stay. She meets a friend, Fiona, a groupie who has settled into a relationship with Lee, bass player and singer with a rock-band.

together.uk.title: Sort Your Life Out
together.uk.description: Stacey Solomon and her gang - organizer Dilly, carpenter Rob and cleaner Iwan - challenge the Harris-Hawley family to sort their lives out in seven days. They ask the family to try to let go of half their possessions so that the team can then beautifully reorganise their home. Stacey gets to know the family behind the clutter - childhood sweethearts Dan and Char and their two daughters, Mia (11) and Cece (3) - who rent a two-up, two-down from their local council. (Home improvement, House/garden, Reality) - 2023

together.uk.title: Clive Myrie's Italian Roadtrip - Maremma
together.uk.description: As long as the water's warm, Clive loves to swim, so he's enthusiastic about taking a dip in the vast volcanic spring of Saturnia and discovering why Italians believe in the healing power of thermal water. Travelling on through Maremma - a big stretch of country running between Tuscany and Lazio - Clive stays in a treehouse at a lavender farm and learns how to extract oil from the plants.

amc.us.title: Men in Black II
amc.us.description: Kay and Jay reunite to provide our best line of defense against a seductress who levels the toughest challenge yet to the MIB's mission statement: protecting the earth from the scum of the universe. While investigating a routine crime, Jay uncovers a plot masterminded by Serleena, a Kylothian monster who disguises herself as a lingerie model. When Serleena takes the MIB building hostage, there is only one person Jay can turn to -- his former MIB partner. (Action, Comedy, Science fiction) - 2002

amc.us.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
amc.us.description: Four high school kids discover an old video game console and are drawn into the game's jungle setting, literally becoming the adult avatars they chose. What they discover is that you don't just play Jumanji - you must survive it. To beat the game and return to the real world, they'll have to go on the most dangerous adventure of their lives, discover what Alan Parrish left 20 years ago, and change the way they think about themselves - or they'll be stuck in the game forever. (Adventure, Action, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2017

amc.us.title: Jumanji
amc.us.description: A magical board game unleashes a world of adventure on siblings Peter and Judy Shepherd. While exploring an old mansion, the youngsters find a curious, jungle-themed game called Jumanji in the attic. When they start playing, they free Alan Parrish, who's been stuck in the game's inner world for decades. If they win Jumanji, the kids can free Alan for good, but that means braving giant bugs, ill-mannered monkeys and even stampeding rhinos! (Family, Fantasy, Adventure, Comedy) - 1995

amc.us.title: A League of Their Own
amc.us.description: As America's stock of athletic young men is depleted during World War II, a professional all-female baseball league springs up in the Midwest, funded by publicity-hungry candy maker Walter Harvey (Garry Marshall). Competitive sisters Dottie Hinson (Geena Davis) and Kit Keller (Lori Petty) spar with each other, scout Ernie Capadino (Jon Lovitz) and grumpy has-been coach Jimmy Dugan (Tom Hanks) on their way to fame. Madonna and Rosie O'Donnell co-star as two of the sisters' teammates. (Comedy drama) - 1992

amc.us.title: Hook

Peter must revisit a foggy past in which he abandoned Neverland for family life, leaving Tinkerbell (Julia Roberts) and the Lost Boys to fend for themselves. Given their bitterness toward Peter for growing up -- and their allegiance to their new leader, Rufio -- the old gang may not be happy to see him. (Children, Fantasy, Adventure, Comedy) - 1991

amc.us.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island

Together with helicopter pilot Gabato and Gabato's feisty daughter, Kailani, they set out to find the island and rescue its sole human inhabitant. (Adventure, Fantasy, Action) - 2012

amc.us.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls

He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes. (Comedy, Adventure) - 1995

amc.us.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective

When sadistic mobster Iosef Tarasov (Alfie Allen) and his thugs steal John's prized car and kill the puppy that was a last gift from his wife, John unleashes the remorseless killing machine within and seeks vengeance. Meanwhile, Iosef's father (Michael Nyqvist) -- John's former colleague -- puts a huge bounty on John's head. (Action, Thriller, Adventure, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2014

Two groups of gunfighters, one led by aging former bandit William Munny (Clint Eastwood), the other by the florid English Bob (Richard Harris), come to collect the reward, clashing with each other and the sheriff. cinemax.us.title: The Shape of Water
cinemax.us.description: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank. (Fantasy, Drama, Romance, Science fiction) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
cinemax.us.description: Dr. Steven Murphy is a renowned cardiovascular surgeon who presides over a spotless household with his wife and two children. Lurking at the margins of his idyllic suburban existence is Martin, a fatherless teen who insinuates himself into the doctor's life in gradually unsettling ways. Soon, the full scope of Martin's intent becomes menacingly clear when he confronts Steven with a long-forgotten transgression that will shatter his domestic bliss forever. (Thriller, Horror) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
cinemax.us.description: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (Action, Comedy) - 2020

cinemax.us.title: The Usual Suspects
cinemax.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

cinemax.us.title: Buffaloed
cinemax.us.description: A woman is desperate to escape her life in Buffalo and finds a way by becoming a debt collector. (Comedy) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Aniara
cinemax.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe. (Science fiction, Drama) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Trance
cinemax.us.description: Simon (James McAvoy), a fine-art auctioneer, joins a gang of thieves led by Franck (Vincent Cassel) to steal a priceless Goya painting. During the heist Simon suffers a head injury and awakes with no memory of where he hid the artwork. When torture and physical threats fail to break through his amnesia, Franck hires a hypnotherapist named Elizabeth (Rosario Dawson) to find the answer. But as Elizabeth probes the recesses of Simon's mind, the lines between truth and deceit start to blur. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Judy
cinemax.us.description: Thirty years after starring in "The Wizard of Oz," beloved actress and singer Judy Garland arrives in London to perform sold-out shows at the Talk of the Town nightclub. While there, she reminisces with friends and fans and begins a whirlwind romance with musician Mickey Deans, her soon-to-be fifth husband. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Jazz) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: My Blind Brother
cinemax.us.description: Bill has always lived in the shadow of his overachieving brother Robbie, an arrogant athlete and local celebrity who happens to be blind. After years of thanklessly helping Robbie achieve one goal after another, Bill finally catches a break when he finds a connection with the charming Rose, who is dealing with her own crisis. But when Rose starts dating Robbie, Bill must decide if he can finally put his own happiness over his brother's and compete for the ultimate prize. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Happy Death Day
cinemax.us.description: Tree Gelbman is a blissfully self-centered collegian who wakes up on her birthday in the bed of a student named Carter. As the morning goes on, Tree gets the eerie feeling that she's experienced the events of this day before. When a masked killer suddenly takes her life in a brutal attack, she once again magically wakes up in Carter's dorm room unharmed. Now, the frightened young woman must relive the same day over and over until she figures out who murdered her. (Horror, Thriller, Comedy, Mystery) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

cinemax.us.title: Blair Witch
cinemax.us.description: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined. (Horror, Thriller) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

cinemax.us.title: My Soul to Take
cinemax.us.description: In the small town of Riverton, a local legend tells of a serial killer's oath to come back and kill the seven children who were born on the night he supposedly died. Now 16 years later, Riverton residents are disappearing again, making some wonder if the legend is true. Bug (Max Thieriot), plagued by nightmares all his life, is one of the so-called Riverton Seven, and it's up to him to save his friends from an evil that will not rest. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Body at Brighton Rock
cinemax.us.description: Wendy, a part-time summer employee at a mountainous state park, takes on a rough trail assignment at the end of the season, trying to prove to her friends that she's capable enough to do the job. When she takes a wrong turn and ends up deep in the backcountry, she stumbles upon what might be a potential crime scene. Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run. (Thriller) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

cinemax.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
cinemax.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Dark comedy) - 1971

cinemax.us.title: Black Butterfly
cinemax.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: The East
cinemax.us.description: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Extraction
cinemax.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. (Thriller, Action) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: Scream
cinemax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

cinemax.us.title: Catfish
cinemax.us.description: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person. (Documentary, Drama, Mystery) - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Our Kind of Traitor
cinemax.us.description: A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis). (Thriller) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: The Greatest Showman
cinemax.us.description: Growing up in the early 1800s, P.T. Barnum displays a natural talent for publicity and promotion, selling lottery tickets by age 12. After trying his hands at various jobs, P.T. turns to show business to indulge his limitless imagination, rising from nothing to create the Barnum & Bailey circus. Featuring catchy musical numbers, exotic performers and daring acrobatic feats, Barnum's mesmerizing spectacle soon takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth. (Musical, Biography, Historical drama) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Walk the Line
cinemax.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Country, Rock) - 2005

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's 11
cinemax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Man
cinemaxaction.us.description: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler, who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie) - 2005-09-09

cinemaxaction.us.title: Due Date
cinemaxaction.us.description: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan. (Comedy, Comedy drama, Dark comedy, Drama, Movie) - 2010-11-05

cinemaxaction.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemaxaction.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Biography, Comedy, Comedy drama, Docudrama, Drama) - 2023-09-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemaxaction.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition. (Action, Adventure, Crime, Drama, Movie) - 2011-12-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: Arctic
cinemaxaction.us.description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive. (Adventure, Drama, Movie) - 2018-05-10

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemaxaction.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (Crime drama, Movie, Romance, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2011-03-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: Holla
cinemaxaction.us.description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness. (Comedy, Horror, Movie) - 2006

cinemaxaction.us.title: Mothra vs. Godzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: Japan comes under attack from two monsters in a giant monster battle between a rampaging Godzilla and the colossal genetically engineered moth called Mothra. (Action, Drama, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1964-04-29

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: An Okinawan monster-god helps Godzilla defeat his bionic double. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1974-03-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. King Ghidorah
cinemaxaction.us.description: Time-travelers' efforts to prevent a dinosaur's mutation result in the creation of a three-headed dragon that terrorizes Japan. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1991-12-14

cinemaxaction.us.title: Spring Breakers
cinemaxaction.us.description: College students Candy (Vanessa Hudgens), Faith (Selena Gomez), Brit (Ashley Benson) and Cotty (Rachel Korine) are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet are unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime. (Comedy, Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie) - 2012-11-23

cinemaxaction.us.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
cinemaxaction.us.description: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages. (Holiday, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 1995-09-29

cinemaxaction.us.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
cinemaxaction.us.description: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former babysitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason. (Holiday, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 1998-07-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Halloween: Resurrection
cinemaxaction.us.description: He's back for more... When a group of teens wins a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. But things go frightfully wrong and the game turns into a struggle to make it out of the house alive. (Holiday, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2002-07-12

cinemaxaction.us.description: Tree Gelbman is a blissfully self-centered collegian who wakes up on her birthday in the bed of a student named Carter. As the morning goes on, Tree gets the eerie feeling that she's experienced the events of this day before. When a masked killer suddenly takes her life in a brutal attack, she once again magically wakes up in Carter's dorm room unharmed. cinemaxaction.us.title: Atomic Blonde
cinemaxaction.us.description: Sensual and savage, Lorraine Broughton is the most elite spy in MI6, an agent who's willing to use all of her lethal skills to stay alive during an impossible mission. With the Berlin Wall about to fall, she travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. Once there, she teams up with an embedded station chief to navigate her way through the deadliest game of spies. (Action, LGBTQ, Movie, Thriller) - 2017-07-28

cinemaxaction.us.title: Megan Leavey
cinemaxaction.us.description: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy. (Biography, Drama, Movie, War) - 2017-06-09

cinemaxaction.us.title: Adult Best Friends
cinemaxaction.us.description: Katie takes her best friend, Delaney, on a nostalgic trip to their childhood hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a chance encounter with a former classmate, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests. (Comedy, Movie) - 2024-06-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: Game Night
cinemaxaction.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie, Mystery) - 2018-02-23

cinemaxaction.us.description: Simon (James McAvoy), a fine-art auctioneer, joins a gang of thieves led by Franck (Vincent Cassel) to steal a priceless Goya painting. cinemaxaction.us.title: The Apparition
cinemaxaction.us.description: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2012-08-24

cinemaxaction.us.title: Enemy
cinemaxaction.us.description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs. (Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2013-12-13

cinemaxaction.us.title: Destroy All Monsters!
cinemaxaction.us.description: Scientists face Godzilla, Rodan, Mothra and more obscure Japanese monsters sent by she-aliens. (Action, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1968-08-01

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ghidorah, the Three-Headed Monster
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla, Rodan and Mothra team up to save mankind from the deadliest threat of all -- a fire-breathing space monster. (Action, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1964-12-20

cinemaxaction.us.title: Blood Simple
cinemaxaction.us.description: "Blood Simple" was the first feature film from Joel and Ethan Coen. This is the newly restored and re-edited director's cut of the film, introduced by Mortimer Young. The stylish crime thriller premiered at film festivals in 1984. "Blood Simple" begins deep in the heart of Texas, where a jealous saloon owner hires a cheap divorce detective to kill the saloon owner's younger wife and her bartender lover. But the detective gets a better idea: he follows the two lovers, and... (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1984-07-07

cinemaxaction.us.title: Extraction
cinemaxaction.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2015-12-18

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Rover
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the near future, mankind's greed and excesses have pushed civilization to the breaking point. Society is in decline, and the rule of law has disintegrated. Hardened drifter Eric (Guy Pearce) wanders across this dangerous and desolate landscape. When thieves steal Eric's car -- and only remaining possession -- they leave behind Rey (Robert Pattinson), a wounded comrade. Eric forces Rey to help him hunt down the gang in an unrelenting quest to take back the one thing that matters to him. (Crime, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2014-06-13

cinemaxaction.us.title: Mickey 17
cinemaxaction.us.description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact. (Adventure, Comedy, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2025-01-31

cinemaxaction.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
cinemaxaction.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2011-08-05

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
cinemaxclassics.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Lara Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Mystery) - 1992-05-16

cinemaxwest.us.description: Tree Gelbman is a blissfully self-centered collegian who wakes up on her birthday in the bed of a student named Carter. As the morning goes on, Tree gets the eerie feeling that she's experienced the events of this day before. When a masked killer suddenly takes her life in a brutal attack, she once again magically wakes up in Carter's dorm room unharmed. Now, the frightened young woman must relive the same day over and over until she figures out who murdered her. (Horror, Thriller, Comedy, Mystery) - 2017

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemaxwest.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

cinemaxwest.us.title: Blair Witch
cinemaxwest.us.description: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined. (Horror, Thriller) - 2016

cinemaxwest.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemaxwest.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

cinemaxwest.us.title: My Soul to Take
cinemaxwest.us.description: In the small town of Riverton, a local legend tells of a serial killer's oath to come back and kill the seven children who were born on the night he supposedly died. Now 16 years later, Riverton residents are disappearing again, making some wonder if the legend is true. Bug (Max Thieriot), plagued by nightmares all his life, is one of the so-called Riverton Seven, and it's up to him to save his friends from an evil that will not rest. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2010

cinemaxwest.us.title: Body at Brighton Rock
cinemaxwest.us.description: Wendy, a part-time summer employee at a mountainous state park, takes on a rough trail assignment at the end of the season, trying to prove to her friends that she's capable enough to do the job. When she takes a wrong turn and ends up deep in the backcountry, she stumbles upon what might be a potential crime scene. Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run. (Thriller) - 2019

cinemaxwest.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemaxwest.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

cinemaxwest.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
cinemaxwest.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Dark comedy) - 1971

cinemaxwest.us.title: Black Butterfly
cinemaxwest.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

cinemaxwest.us.title: The East
cinemaxwest.us.description: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama) - 2013

cinemaxwest.us.title: Extraction

cinemaxwest.us.title: Scream

Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

cinemaxwest.us.title: Catfish

Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person. (Documentary, Drama, Mystery) - 2010

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Greatest Showman

Featuring catchy musical numbers, exotic performers and daring acrobatic feats, Barnum's mesmerizing spectacle soon takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth. cinemaxwest.us.title: Walk the Line

freeform.us.title: Ice Age
freeform.us.description: Twenty-thousand years ago, Earth was a wondrous, prehistoric world filled with great danger, not the least of which is the beginning of the Ice Age. To avoid a terrible frostbite, the planet's majestic creatures - and a few small, slothful ones - begin migrating south. The story revolves around sub-zero heroes: a woolly mammoth, a saber-toothed tiger, a sloth and a prehistoric combination of a squirrel and rat, known as Scrat. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2002

freeform.us.title: Ice Age: The Meltdown
freeform.us.description: With global warming threatening their once-icy domain with widespread flooding, Manny (Ray Romano), Sid (John Leguizamo) and Diego (Denis Leary) set out to find a safe haven. Along the way, another mammoth (Queen Latifah), who thinks she is an opossum, joins the travelers on their perilous quest. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2006

freeform.us.title: Dumbo
freeform.us.description: A young circus elephant is born with comically large ears and given the cruel nickname Dumbo. One day at a show, he is taunted by a group of kids, inciting his mother into a rage that gets her locked up. After Dumbo's ears cause an accident that injures many of the other elephants, he is made to dress like a clown and perform dangerous stunts. Everything changes when Dumbo discovers that his enormous ears actually allow him to fly, and he astounds everyone at the circus with his new talent. (Animated, Children, Fantasy) - 1941

freeform.us.title: The Pacifier
freeform.us.description: Elite Navy SEAL Shane Wolfe (Vin Diesel) can handle just about anything thrown his way, but even the best have their limits. When he fails to keep scientist Howard Plummer (Tate Donovan) safe from assassination, Wolfe has a shot at redemption by being assigned to protect Plummer's five children, including rebellious Zoe (Brittany Snow), Seth (Max Thieriot) and clingy Lulu (Morgan York). More than a handful, these kids -- and their pet duck -- are pushing this seasoned warrior to the edge. (Children, Comedy) - 2005

freeform.us.title: Jingle All the Way
freeform.us.description: Workaholic Howard Langston (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wants to make things up to his son, Jamie (Jake Lloyd), and wife, Liz (Rita Wilson). He promises to get Jamie the hottest toy of the season, Turbo-Man -- even though it's Christmas Eve and the toy is practically sold out. As Langston hunts down the elusive gift, he runs into mailman Myron (Sinbad), another father on the same quest. With the clock winding down, Langston's moral code is tested as he starts to learn the real meaning of Christmas. (Family, Holiday, Comedy) - 1996

freeform.us.title: Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas

freeform.us.title: Inside Out
freeform.us.description: Riley (Kaitlyn Dias) is a happy, hockey-loving 11-year-old Midwestern girl, but her world turns upside-down when she and her parents move to San Francisco. Riley's emotions -- led by Joy (Amy Poehler) -- try to guide her through this difficult, life-changing event. However, the stress of the move brings Sadness (Phyllis Smith) to the forefront. When Joy and Sadness are inadvertently swept into the far reaches of Riley's mind, the only emotions left in Headquarters are Anger, Fear and Disgust. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2015

freeform.us.title: Inside Out 2
freeform.us.description: Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust have been running a successful operation by all accounts. However, when Anxiety shows up, they aren't sure how to feel. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2024

freeform.us.title: Raya and the Last Dragon
