antennatv.us.title: My Two Dads
antennatv.us.description: Joey and Michael, who fought over the same woman 13 years ago now have, upon her death, been awarded joint custody of her daughter - who might be either of theirs. So how do the men settle their problems? With a paternity test? No way. Instead, they all move in together to raise Nicole as a two-dad nuclear family. Under the watchful eye of the family court judge, dads and daughter adjust to their new situation. (Sitcom) - 1987-09-20

antennatv.us.title: The Facts of Life
antennatv.us.description: "You take the good, you take the bad ... ." Originally set at the prestigious Eastland School for Young Women, housemother Mrs. Garrett is the caretaker and confidante of a special group of girls. Over time, this group shrinks to be centered on only four young women: wealthy and spoiled Blair, gossipy Tootie, eager-to-please Natalie and tough girl Jo. Over the years, the girls graduate from school, and the story lines evolve with them. (Sitcom) - 1979-08-24

antennatv.us.title: Soap
antennatv.us.description: This classic comedy series is a satire on all the daytime soaps out there. The stories revolve around a rich family, the Tates, and a blue-collar family, the Campbells. With stories mostly centered around crazy characters and sex, the escapades are as soapy as you can get: divorce, homosexuality, adultery, kidnapping, organized crime, war flashbacks, custody battles, murder and amnesia. (Soap, Sitcom) - 1977-09-13

antennatv.us.title: Benson
antennatv.us.description: Butler Benson DuBois is the smartest (and possibly only sane) member of widowed Gov. Eugene Gatling's household staff. Benson always manages to keep his head, no matter what the staffers or the governor's family members throw at him. He begins his post on loan from his employer, Jessica Tate (Katherine Helmond) on the show "Soap," but soon wins a permanent place in the governor's staff and heart. His cool head and keen intellect are a perfect complement for the constant craziness that surrounds Gov. Gatling and his entourage. (Sitcom) - 1979-09-13

arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E08 The Second Black President Episode Kevin is torn between running a clean campaign for class president and being negative about his opponent.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E31 The Kevin Gets a Commercial Episode Kevin auditions for a commercial for the mall burger joint and ends up being replaced by a famous kid actor that looks just like him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E46 The Black Friday Episode Comical chaos ensues when the gang waits in line to shop at a department store on Black Friday. Kevin anticipates buying a new video game, Lindsey meets a boy, relationship problems plague Martin and Terrence hopes to buy toys for charity.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E12 The Parent Teacher Trap Episode When Suzanne gets roped into a committee at Kevin's school, where the other mums are mean to her, Nick volunteers to fill in on her behalf, making things awkward when the ladies love him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E09 The She Got Game Night Episode When the Kingston-Persons decide to have a game night, all bets are off, as unlikely friends are drawn to one another when paired together for games.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E33 The Mother's Day Episode Nick tricks Suzanne and Marilyn into spending a weekend together at a spa for Mother's Day, where it becomes clear it will take more than a masseuse to relieve the tension in the women's relationship.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E02 The Credit Check Episode Nick needs a new van for work, but Suzanne worries they are already too much in debt and cannot afford to buy a new one; Suzanne has some credit issues she has not revealed to Nick.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E03 The Oh No She Di-in't Episode When Nick's new field producer, Sam, turns out to be female, Suzanne is convinced she is trying to steal her man, a suggestion Nick thinks is absurd until Sam actually makes a move on him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E53 The Good Day Seattle Episode The station launches a new morning show, but Nick's cohost is a self-serving reality star; Marilyn moves in with the family.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E08 The Michelle Obama Sweater Episode Using her mother's credit card, Lindsey gets help from Nick in ordering a Michelle Obama sweater online; Kevin pretends to be sick to pull off a scam to get a signed A-Rod jersey.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E12 The Tiger Dad Episode Nick becomes a more influential parent, so he pushes Kevin and Lindsey hard, and they become model children.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E28 The Nick Hosts a Telethon Episode Despite warnings from other co-workers, Nick gets stuck hosting a charity telethon; Suzanne has to deal with a rich client's boring wedding plans.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E10 The Despicable E Episode Lindsey's romantic attentions turn to a young celebrity DJ, who only neglects her in return; Suzanne teaches Kevin the art of doing laundry.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E06 The Booty Episode Nick goes to watch a game with friends at a sports bar known to have sexy female waitresses; the kids want a larger allowance, but they're not willing to do more chores.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E15 The First .45 Episode When Lindsay tries to turn family members into stars of a reality television show, Kevin makes a discovery that brings too much reality to the Kingston-Persons household.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E04 The Soccer Episode Kevin is a big football fan, but Nick does not understand the appeal; Suzanne is frustrated by Lindsey's lack of communication and creates a fake Facebook account to learn what is going on.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E35 The Life Insurance Episode Although Nick and Suzanne realize that life insurance would be a good decision to protect their family, Nick has reservations about buying a policy.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E07 The Viral Video Episode Suzanne gets caught dancing on a video that soon becomes a huge viral hit; Marilyn decides Lindsey needs to learn how to cook soul food.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E36 The Hypertension Episode When Nick gets a doctor's report that he has high blood pressure, Suzanne does everything she can to make sure his stress levels stay low.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E25 The Mr. Almost Episode When Nick happens upon an old college pal, the unexpected meeting gives rise to a business plan that involves a sports star and an energy drink; the results are not so bubbly.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E28 The Liar, Liar Episode Suzanne begins to force everyone in the family to tell the truth at all times after she catches Nick in a lie.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E34 The Secret Episode Lindsey has a new crush and Gigi has a new boyfriend, but when certain secrets cannot be kept, a web of misinformation nearly ruins both situations.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E17 The Lemon Squeeze Episode When the family's morning routine devolves into fighting, Gigi suggests that they try an old sorority exercise called the Lemon Squeeze in order to turn their problems around.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E31 The Kwandanegaba Children's Fund Episode Nick wants Lindsey and Kevin to give back to the community, so they select a charity they find online; when the charity keeps asking for more money, Nick has to get to the bottom of it.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E21 The V.I.P. Tickets Episode Suzanne is furious when Nick invites Martin and not her to a baseball game; Kevin and Lindsey try to win tickets to Rihanna's Los Angeles concert.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E01 The Staycation Episode When Nick messes up Suzanne's plans for spring break, he turns the house into a makeshift resort, and promises to give the family the best vacation ever.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E23 The Compatibility Test Episode Suzanne meets a relationship adviser and becomes convinced that she and Nick are having compatibility issues.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E26 The Big Loan Episode Confusion ensues when Suzanne asks Marilyn for a loan in an attempt to keep her birthday present a secret for Nick.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E15 The Control Issue Episode When Nick points out that Suzanne has issues letting go of controlling everything, Suzanne lets everything go; the family realizes they need Suzanne's controlling ways to run a successful household.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E48 The Concussion Episode After a concussion, Nick is advised to not go to bed for a few hours; to avoid all risks, he attempts to stay up all night.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E19 The Disney Episode Nick is invited to play in a celebrity golf tournament at Walt Disney World; Suzanne has to miss the family's first vacation.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E04 The 22 Episode When the family oversleeps on the morning Lindsey is set to sing the National Anthem at a baseball game, it is all hands on deck just to make it to out of the house on time.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E30 The Silent Treatment Episode Nick and Suzanne stop talking to each other after Suzanne gets upset with Nick for his attempts to fix her problems without listening to her.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E02 The Thief Episode Nick refuses to give Lindsey money for a concert, so Lindsey resorts to stealing sixty dollars from Gigi's purse; when Gigi discovers the missing money, she blames Kevin for the theft.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E17 The Fall of Troy Episode When Troy provokes a school bully, Kevin strikes up a friendship with his tormentor to avoid a beat down; Kevin soon faces a difficult decision.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E10 The Get-Together Episode Nick notices the family is disconnected and proposes a get-together with friends and family so they have the opportunity to reconnect; Nick's planning leaves out some important details, leading to chaos.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E43 The Timeshare Episode Marilyn begins to date a younger man, but Nick doubts his true intentions. Meanwhile, Kevin breaks his arm.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E04 The Nick's Manny Pedi Episode When Suzanne crashes a night with Nick and his boys, Nick decides he needs to pay her back by showing up for spa treatments with Suzanne and her girlfriends to show her what it is like.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E27 The Family Portrait Episode Suzanne wants to have a formal portrait of the family taken, but trying to pull everyone together proves to be impossible.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E34 The Lindsey Goes Vegan Episode When Lindsey decides to adopt a vegan lifestyle, Suzanne convinces Nick they should go vegan as well; they come to regret this decision when they learn the extent of Lindsey's dedication.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E32 The Blockbuster Movie Episode Nick and Suzanne try to attend a highly anticipated movie premiere, but when their busy schedules get in the way, both are tempted to secretly go to the movie without the other.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E13 The Whose Card Is It Anyway Episode Suzanne and Nick go on a "People's Court TV" show when Nick lies about having spent a gift card Suzanne gave him, which she finds and spends on herself, calling him on his lie.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E27 The Lindsey Gets High Episode Lindsey freaks out when a friend offers her a drug; she gets a lesson on drugs from former child-star Todd Bridges who takes her on a wild ride.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E22 The Lindsey Dances Episode Lindsey auditions to dance in a P-Nut music video, but considers quitting when she discovers that the choreographer is a drill sergeant and the other dancers are far more experienced.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E37 The Satchel Pagge Episode Nick is looking for a man with a voice of gold; Suzanne loses Gigi's expensive sweater.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E24 The House Sitter's Episode When the house sitters next door begin acting irresponsibly, Nick and Suzanne question if they are being played for fools.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E21 The Nick Gets Jealous Episode Nick asks Suzanne to help pro basketball player Ray Savage plan a children's charity event, but gets worried when he learns of Ray's reputation as a womanizer.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E25 The Nick Gets Promoted Episode Nick struggles to prove himself when he is promoted to co-host alongside the lazy, arrogant Brick Street.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E52 The Spelling Bee Episode Nick meets a famous actor and shadows him to prepare for an upcoming role; Kevin studies for a spelling bee.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E47 The Wrong Way Episode Nick hesitantly attends his high school reunion, but all of his fears come true when his high school nickname haunts him throughout the event; Lindsey prepares a feast.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E06 The Gold Party Episode Marilyn throws a gold party; Nick discovers Suzanne's wedding ring is not actually real and sets out to have a real ring made before she learns the truth, while Suzanne thinks she has lost her wedding ring forever.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E10 The Father's Day Episode Nick is disappointed when Frank crashes his Father's Day trip; when an elevator stops, the men are forced to have a meaningful heart-to-heart.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E07 The Suzanne Gets Arrested Episode When Suzanne's stubborn need to argue her point gets her arrested, she starts to change her ways, but not necessarily for the better.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E41 The Insignificant Anniversary Episode Nick forgets an anniversary while the children star in internet videos wearing superhero costumes as they give out advice to users.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E42 The Open Mic Gaffe Episode Nick insults a work colleague forgetting his microphone is on; the children help Marilyn become more internet savvy.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E39 The Inappropriate Website Episode Nick pulls up an adult website at work on accident; Suzanne stays at home for a couch delivery; Lindsey studies for a Shakespeare test.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E19 The Tit for Tat Episode When a new woman gets hired at the station, Nick's career is threatened; Suzanne takes matters into her own hands to save her husband's job.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E56 The Identity Theft Episode Nick's identity is stolen; Suzanne takes a week off to attend a wedding; Marilyn shares a life lesson.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E11 The Valentine's Day Episode Nick lends a hand to Kevin for his Valentine's Day at school, but things take a turn as Kevin ends up being sent home.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E16 The Take Your Kids to Work Day Episode When Lindsey accompanies Suzanne to work and meets an old friend of her mother's; a misunderstanding causes Lindsey to believe she may have an older brother that she never knew about.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E22 The Test Taker Episode Kevin assists Frankie in preparing for an exam, but Frankie offers a bribe to persuade Kevin to take the test on his behalf.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E26 The Play Date Episode Suzanne and Nick go out with another couple, her friend Danielle and husband Steve; the double date soon fizzles when an accusation flies.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E30 The Nick's Kid Episode Suzanne learns the mother of Kevin's new friend Nathan is Nick's old fling; she suspects that Nathan could be Nick's son.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E55 The Sex Symbol Episode After a website votes Nick Sexiest Seattle Sportscaster, he tries to embrace his new image; Nick soon learns being a sex symbol isn't all it's cracked up to be.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E49 The Bucket List Episode Nick creates a bucket list of very dangerous activities; Kevin and Troy launch an underground candy operation at school.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E05 The Boy Has Style Episode Suzanne suspects that Lindsey's athletic new crush from school is gay; Nick sets out to prove that he is not in order to save Lindsey from facing disappointment.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E38 The Cyrano Episode Nick helps a coworker by writing love letters to a woman on a dating site, only to find that the woman getting the letters is Gigi.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E03 The Day Off Episode Nick decides the kids need to bond with his mother and asks that they spend time together; Suzanne has a day off, but she does not know what to do, now that she has a lot of time on her hands.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E13 The Expensive Purse Episode After balking at the high price of a purse Suzanne loves, Nick thinks again and tries to buy it as a gift, but Suzanne has already secretly bought the last purse for herself.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E03 The Bad Dream Episode After Kevin watches the horror film "The Sixth Sense," he starts having nightmares that disrupt Nick and Suzanne's sleep.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E01 The Mr. Himdependent Episode When Suzanne's ex-husband wants to lower his monthly child support payments, Nick jumps at the chance while Suzanne has mixed feelings about Frank abandoning his own responsibilities.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E14 The Master of Ceremonies Episode While hosting an awards ceremony, Nick gets laughs by making Suzanne the butt of his jokes, but finds he cannot stand the heat when Suzanne turns the tables and starts making fun of him in public.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E51 The Hand on a House Episode Lindsey and Kevin enter Nick into a Hand on a House contest, where finalists compete by seeing who can keep their hand on a house for the longest.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E29 The Nick Gets an Assistant Episode Nick is forced to get an assistant, who is a must-hire from his boss; when the assistant gets too close to his family and friends, Nick is forced to take action.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E05 The Rat in the House Episode When a rat gets lost in the home, Kevin scurries to care for it. Meanwhile, an ex-flame creates surging tension between Lindsey and Gigi.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?

John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence. (Action) - 1996

backstage.us.title: Belly

Buns, on the other hand, sinks deeper into criminality and faces serious prison time. The cops offer him a deal, however -- assassinate the head of the Muslim group, and he will go free. backstage.us.title: The Substitute 2: School's Out

bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Bordeaux Heading to autumnal Bordeaux; Rick arrives just in time to judge a local wine contest; he hires a 2CV for an excursion to the coast that is abundant with mussels and oysters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Reykjavik Rick Stein heads north towards the Arctic Circle to explore the food of Reykjavík; a perfect winter break is enriched with roast lamb, rye bread baked in volcanic sand, langoustine soup and cod.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Berlin Rick enjoys a long weekend in Berlin, where history and the Avant-garde dwell side by side; a city that once made history with its divisive wall teems today with an array of innovative chefs offering seasonal creations like puréed sunflower seeds.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Long Weekends
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Vienna Rick Stein visits Vienna, the city that once ran the Austro-Hungarian Empire and continues to be home to dishes like tafelspitz and goulash; Vienna gave its name to one of Europe's most popular dishes, the wiener schnitzel.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Rachel explores Melbourne's Chinatown, tastes some of the cities infamous coffee and checks out the new type of restaurant taking over Australia's food-loving capital.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Rachel pays a visit to a century-old milk bar and a bar serving up some twists on Aussie classics before meeting up with Kate Gibbs, the granddaughter of legendary Aussie cook Margaret Fulton.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Rachel explores some of the city's outer edges, where she discovers authentic and tasty croissants, before meeting up with seasonal cooking advocate Matt Wilkinson.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Rachel takes a trip to the Bellarine Peninsula, an up-and-coming foodies' paradise, where she meets up with a mussel trawler, winery owner and cheese maker.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rachel shines a spotlight on Melbourne's sport fanatics' favorite gourmet fast food and cooks up a storm with the city's original food truck proprietor.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Keen to explore this melting pot of cuisines, Rachel explores a Vietnamese food market, tracks down a suburban hot bed of Greek eats, and learns how to make passata from an Italian-Australian nonna.

bbcfood.us.title: Rachel Khoo's Kitchen Notebook Melbourne
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Rachel explores one of the lesser-known regions on Melbourne's doorstep, the Dandenongs, where she meets up with Argentinian chef Mauro Callegari.

bouncetv.us.description: James Brown was born in extreme poverty in 1933 South Carolina and survived abandonment, abuse and jail to become one of the most influential musicians of the 20th century. He joined a gospel group as a teenager, but the jazz and blues along the "chitlin' circuit" became his springboard to fame. Although his backup musicians came and went, Brown retained the ability to mesmerize audiences with his music, signature moves and sexual energy. (Biography, Docudrama) - 2014

Through the guidance of his new doctor, he confronts his painful past and begins a quest to find the family he never knew. (Drama) - 2002

bouncetv.us.title: All Eyez on Me

(Biography, Drama, Music, Hip-Hop & rap) - 2017

bravovault.us.description: S06 E01 RSVPeeved As Charleston reels over Thomas' arrest, Kathryn deals with conflicting emotions; Cameran struggles to balance motherhood and her career; the friends gather at Patricia's dinner party, during which they are shocked by the revelation of a secret romp.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E02 Kat's Out of the Bag Cameran gives Eliza an earful about her behavior at Patricia's party; Whitney is in the hot seat over rumors about his relationship status; Chelsea hosts a housewarming party; Cameran spills the beans about Whitney and Kathryn's secret liaison.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E03 Slide Into Your DMs Like... Naomie juggles her clothing company and her family's restaurant empire; as Kathryn opens up about her new boyfriend, Craig becomes the town gossip, spreading rumors about Kat's new man and Austen's girlfriend.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E04 Barking Up the Wrong Tree House Austen has second thoughts about breaking up with Madison; Chelsea learns Austen has been badmouthing her around town; a shocking experience gives Eliza a new lease on life; Kathryn pulls another one of her stunts before the girls' trip.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E05 In Sew Deep Kathryn and Danni leave the girls' trip on frosty terms; Cameran realizes she needs to get back to work; Craig decides to host a party to trick his friends into helping him sew pillows; Chelsea lays into Austen for talking behind her back.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E06 A Salt and Battery To get Austen's mind off his ex, the guys rent an RV and head into the great outdoors; Chelsea steps up her hair game; Eliza tries to mend fences; Cam finally asks for help with Palmer; Kathryn and Danni's friendship is at an icy standstill.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E07 Dick Moves and Dick Pics The guys hit the town in Nashville, Tenn., in their attempt to get Austen over Madison; Patricia hosts a female-only dinner party that is even raunchier than the boys' night out, as the women share some secrets of their own.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E08 New Craig, Who Dis? Shep adjusts to life with his new puppy, Little Craig; Chelsea holds Austen's feet to the fire; Kathryn and Naomie get enlightened; when Cameran hosts an oyster roast for her 35th birthday party, she gets "turnt," and Craig the human gets livid.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E09 Sorry Not Sorry The group decides to take a trip to Colorado to help Cameran rediscover her mojo; Naomie refuses to go; Eliza hosts the gang for a day of skeet shooting at her family's plantation and invites a blast from the past, which backfires big time.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E10 Rocky Mountain High Part One Kathryn confronts Whitney about a rumor; Cameran reveals to Shep that she's invited Madison to her birthday ski trip in Colorado; the trip gets off to a rocky start as a frustrated Craig unleashes his pent-up fury.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E11 Rocky Mountain High Part Two Chelsea, Cameran, Eliza, Danni, and Kathryn hit the slopes for their first-ever ski lesson, while Craig, Austen and Madison go snowboarding; Austen and Madison's relationship heats up; tensions arise during a cannabis-infused dinner.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E12 Who Put the Mad in Madison? After a raucous night in Colorado, Cameran and Whitney hightail it back to Charleston, while the others hit the hot springs; Austen and Madison's road to reconciliation is a rocky one; Madison repeats a rumor that throws Shep and Danni under the bus.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E13 Outfoxed Shep's ultimatum to Austen is tested after he and Madison reconcile; Ashley asks for another chance, and Eliza invites her to the fox hunt; Ashley and Kathryn come face to face for the first time in a year, and the gang prepares for a brawl.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S06 E14 White Gloves Off The socialites get ready for another grand event hosted by Miss Patricia; battle lines are drawn when Austen learns that Shep and Craig's dates are the women from his infamous threesome video; Ashley considers crashing the event.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S07 E01 The Good Shephard Austen and Madison's bond is stronger than ever; Kathryn reveals a bit of gossip to Craig; with a new girlfriend and a therapist in tow, Shep's new and improved attitude leaves him determined to keep his nose out of everyone's business.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S07 E02 Charleston Whine and Food Festival Shep continues to spread gossip at his party, upsetting Madison and ultimately affecting his friendship with Austen; Leva comes to Cameran's defense and confronts Kathryn for igniting the rumor mill; Patricia suggests John pursue Madison.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S07 E03 A Pair and a Spare Leva hosts a Persian dinner for the girls; the boys discover John doesn't honor bro-code; Shep and Taylor double-date with Austen and Madison; Kathryn finds out a secret about Thomas.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S07 E04 Single and Ready to Pringle Despite tensions among the guys, they prepare for Patricia's annual dinner party; John follows Patricia's advice and decides to pursue Madison, even though he would be breaking bro-code with Austen; Charleston deals with the onset of coronavirus.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S07 E05 Monumental Challenge Charleston reopens with big changes due to the pandemic and social unrest; everyone comes to grips with the new normal.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S07 E06 Love Sick John cozies up to Madison as she reaches a decision about Austen; after Craig debuts his HSN line, Patricia has an announcement of her own; Shep and his girlfriend struggle with the pressures of quarantine; Leva confronts Kathryn.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S07 E07 Low Country Broil Shep tries to charm his way out of the doghouse with Taylor; after an apology tour, Kathryn continues to face backlash for her exchange on social media; Austen refuses to accept that his relationship with Madison is over.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S07 E08 It's My Party and I'll Go If I Want To... On the heels of their breakup, Madison invites everyone to what was supposed to be Austen's birthday party; Kathryn struggles in her friendships with Danni and Madison Simon.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S07 E09 Treehouse of Cards Pt. 1 Pringle and Shep co-host a pool party; Leva finally calls out the boys on their unyielding defense of Kathryn; Austen looks to close the chapter on Madison for good.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S07 E10 Treehouse of Cards Pt. 2 Madison learns Austen has been hooking up with another woman; Kathryn finally confronts her DM scandal; fractures in the group threaten friendships.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S08 E01 Great Ex-pectations After a tumultuous year, the Charleston crew is back and ready for a fresh start; Kathryn throws herself a 30th birthday party to celebrate another decade and a clean slate with a new man by her side.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S08 E02 Suspicious Minds Chleb is on the receiving end of Kathryn's anger and makes a big decision; Austen is hurt that Craig didn't tell him about hooking up with Naomie and suspects the former couple is hiding an even bigger secret.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S08 E03 Barbecues, Breakups & Betrothals The boys have a barbecue and while the grill gets hot, the drama does too; Craig looks to Paige for advice on how to mend his friendship with Austen, but Austen's got bigger fish to fry when he learns some shocking news about Madison.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S08 E04 It's My Party and I'll Fight if I Want To Austen gets emotional when he learns his parents are selling his childhood home; Chleb leans on his cousin for support in the wake of his breakup with Kathryn; Shep's past comes back to haunt him when Taylor voices her concerns for their future.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S08 E05 Exes and Uh Oh's Madison and Venita's joint party takes a turn for the worse; Paige sets ground rules for her relationship with Craig; Shep struggles to get Taylor to trust him while he's away; Kathryn sets up a girls' night out to celebrate her new status.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S08 E06 Shuckers and Sinners Shep and Craig help Austen move things out of his childhood home; Taylor voices concerns about Shep's past infidelity back in Charleston; Olivia prepares to throw an oyster roast, and one guest's presence causes Austen to spiral.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S08 E07 Clean Slates and Secret Dates After being excluded from Olivia's oyster roast, Venita looks within and spends time with her mom in hopes of gaining insight into her family's secret past; Craig may have a new secret of his own when he goes against Paige's wishes and meets Naomie.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S08 E08 Holy Mutt-rimony The wedding countdown begins for Lil Craig and Peaches; Shep opens up to Whitney about his marriage fears; Austen sulks when Olivia arrives with a date; Craig and Naomie bump heads on boundaries; maid of honor Madison and best man Austen bump heads.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S08 E09 Auldbrass Glitters Is Not Gold The gang takes a much-needed break from Charleston and heads to Auldbrass, an estate designed by architect Frank Lloyd Wright; Naomie divulges her new love interest to Leva and Austen, who prove they are not the best at keeping secrets.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S08 E10 Walking on Eggshells Tensions continue to rise on the group's trip to Auldbrass; Craig demands apologies; Olivia wrestles with her feelings about Austen; Whitney deals with the repercussions of breaking bro code; an egg toss scrambles Shep and Taylor's relationship.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S08 E11 Guess Who's Coming to Friendsgiving The holiday season is off to a rocky start when the gang gets together for a Friendsgiving feast; Austen hosts and leaves certain people off the guest list; a newly single Kathryn searches for things to be grateful for; Paige comes to town.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S08 E12 Guys and Dolls Patricia invites the guys over for a gentlemen's dinner; the ladies get together for a night out; the girls take the time to face their issues head on.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S08 E13 St. Simon Says Fight! Shep tries to right his wrongs from Auldbrass; Austen expresses concern for Taylor's future with Shep; Craig loses his temper.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S08 E14 Trawlin' and Brawlin' Austen finds it hard to bite his tongue when Shep feels attacked by the group; Naomie leans on her friends for support when Craig lashes out but finds Venita's allegiance is elsewhere.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S08 E15 Wreck the Halls Craig prepares for the gala; Shep reflects on his actions; Venita worries about her friendships; Austen and Olivia make strides in their relationship.

bravovault.us.description: S09 E01 Vows, Vendettas and Vibrators The Charmers celebrate Madison's marriage to her Prince Charming, but everyone isn't in a festive mood; Austen comes face-to-face with multiple exes; Craig gets caught in the crossfire of an icy reunion between Shep and Taylor.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S09 E02 Spilling the JT The spotlight is on the aftermath of accusations spilled at Madison's wedding party, but attention quickly turns when newcomer JT vocalizes his suspicions about Austen and Taylor to Shep.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S09 E03 He Said, She Said The girls decide Taylor needs a good old-fashioned Southern soirée, swapping tales and spillin' tea; Shep kills the fun, however, when he delivers a scandalous rumor to Olivia's front door.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S09 E04 In Vino Veritas After Olivia hears what went down between Austen and Taylor, she's unsure how to move forward; Taylor brings the group together for her first big work event and more rumors bubble to the surface; Shep wastes no time confronting Austen.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S09 E05 Party Fowl Shep attempts to put the group's messiness aside and host a proper Southern dinner for his closest friends; when Olivia learns the truth from Taylor about what really happened with Austen, emotions boil over and Austen gets skewered.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S09 E06 Family Bonds The drama comes to a halt when a tragedy affects the Charmer's close circle, and they rally to support Olivia.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S09 E09 Strange Bedfellows The guys' weekend of fishing and debauchery is interrupted when Olivia and Taylor crash their mountain getaway; tensions flare and Shep erupts after a game of ping pong goes terribly wrong.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S09 E10 A Royal Reckoning Whitney is forced to host the annual Gentleman's Dinner solo; Craig once again questions the timeline of Austen and Taylor's dalliance.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S09 E11 Jamaican Me Crazy Craig decides that the perfect way for Paige to get to know his friends is a group getaway to Jamaica; as they touch down in paradise, Olivia questions where she stands with Austen; Shep keeps his distance from Taylor.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S09 E12 Chasing Waterfalls The Charmers first day in paradise is overshadowed by a salacious article that causes Olivia and Austen's progress to backslide; Madison enjoys her last hurrah before trying for baby a baby.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S09 E13 Choppy Waters The crew spends a day partying on a yacht; despite their fun in the sun, Austen and Shep come to blows.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S09 E14 Playing House As the trip to Jamaica winds down, Olivia and Taylor's relationship comes to a head; back in Charleston, Madison plays host for Paige and Craig, who are confronting tough questions in their relationship.

bravovault.us.title: Southern Charm
bravovault.us.description: S09 E15 Beyond the Valley of the Southern Dolls Whitney throws a bash to celebrate his new man-cave; Shep finally works through his feelings with Taylor; Austen confronts Olivia about simmering tensions; the party goes south when Austen and JT go head-to-head.

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

cinevault.us.title: Brian's Song
cinevault.us.description: Although they both play for the Chicago Bears, Brian Piccolo (Sean Maher) is white, a joker and mostly rides the bench while Gale Sayers (Mekhi Phifer) is black, serious and a rookie superstar. Neither likes the other much, but when coach Halas (Ben Gazzara) makes them the first interracial roommates in the NFL, the two gradually form a sincere friendship. Piccolo helps Sayers overcome an injury, and Sayers later gives Piccolo much needed support when he's diagnosed with terminal cancer. (Docudrama, Movie) - 2001-12-02

cinevault.us.title: Murphy's Romance
cinevault.us.description: Emma (Sally Field), a divorced single mother seeking to start her life over, moves to a small town in Arizona. She builds a relationship with Murphy (James Garner), the older local pharmacist but, due to his age, it remains platonic. Their friendship becomes complicated when Emma's ex-husband, Bobby Jack (Brian Kerwin), shows up. He claims to have changed his ways, but when he turns out to be the same man Emma divorced, she discovers her true feelings for Murphy. (Movie, Romantic comedy) - 1985

cinevault.us.title: Guarding Tess
cinevault.us.description: Doug Chesnic (Nicolas Cage), an agent with the Secret Service Uniformed Division, is assigned to protect former first lady Tess Carlisle (Shirley MacLaine). Chesnic finds the job demeaning and a challenge because of Tess' high-maintenance personality and petty demands. He's desperate to get another assignment, but she insists that he remain head of her security detail, using her influence with the current president to get her way. When she's kidnapped, however, Chesnic's feelings change. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1994-04-30

cinevault.us.title: 28 Days
cinevault.us.description: The story of Gwen Cummings (Sandra Bullock), a successful New York writer living in the fast lane and everyone's favorite party girl -- until she gets drunk with boyfriend Jasper (Dominic West), borrows her sister's (Elizabeth Perkins) wedding limo and earns herself a stay in court-ordered rehab. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 2000-02-08

cinevault.us.title: Legion
cinevault.us.description: For the patrons and staff at a dusty roadside diner, the day begins as usual, but when the phones go out and a sweet old lady goes on the attack, it's a harbinger of the terror to come. As the horrifying nature of the situation sinks in, help arrives in the form of the archangel Michael (Paul Bettany), who tells a pregnant waitress that her unborn baby is humanity's last hope, and he will do anything to protect it. (Fantasy, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2010-01-22

cinevault.us.title: Blue Thunder

cinevault.us.title: Krull
cinevault.us.description: On the planet of Krull, an evil creature called the Beast decimates the world's army and kidnaps the lovely Princess Lyssa, who is destined to become queen. Her brave beau, Prince Colwyn, leads a motley band of warriors, including Ergo and Kegan, to rescue his beloved. However, before he can face the Beast, Colwyn must locate a mystical weapon known as the Glaive, which he can use to slay the hideous villain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 1983-07-29

cinevault.us.title: The Take
cinevault.us.description: Deep in the slums of Los Angeles, good-natured Felix De La Pena (John Leguizamo), a family man and armored vehicle driver, is shot in the head during a hijacking attempt gone wrong. Though his wife, Marina (Rosie Perez), offers her love and support, Felix suffers from intense physical and emotional pain following the attack. As he begins to recover, he learns he has been framed for the stick-up; distraught, Felix decides to find the real culprit himself, despite his failing health and memory. (Action, Crime drama, Movie) - 2007

cinevault.us.title: Felon

cinevault.us.title: White Boy Rick

Federal agents convince his son, Rick Jr., to become an undercover drug informant in exchange for keeping his father out of prison. When young Rick gets in too deep, he finds himself seduced by the lure of easy money and becomes a drug dealer himself. (Biography, Crime drama, Movie) - 2018-08-31

filmriseaction.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmriseaction.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Family, Action, Thriller) - 2006

With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Just Getting Started
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2017

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: 10th and Wolf
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them. (Drama) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Honest Thief
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Hoping to cut a deal, a professional bank robber agrees to return all the money he stole in exchange for a reduced sentence. But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice. (Action, Thriller) - 2020

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Family, Action, Thriller) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Bone Snatcher

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Chef
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love. (Comedy drama) - 2014

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blitz

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The 51st State
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. retroplex.us.title: Oklahoma Annie
retroplex.us.description: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day. (Western, Comedy) - 1952

retroplex.us.title: Borderland
retroplex.us.description: Hopalong Cassidy fools even his partner by acting like a badman to catch a gang of badmen. (Western) - 1937

retroplex.us.title: Massacre
retroplex.us.description: A tribe of hostile Native Americans goes on the warpath, slaughtering white men with guns sold to them by mercenary outlaws. (Western) - 1956

retroplex.us.title: The Proud Rebel
retroplex.us.description: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault — and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland). (Western) - 1958

retroplex.us.title: Dead Birds
retroplex.us.description: William (Henry Thomas), a Confederate soldier, has gone AWOL with a crew of other men. As the group, among it a runaway slave (Isaiah Washington) and a nurse (Nicki Aycox), makes its way along, it stops off to rob a bank clean. Looking to plan a getaway, the gang heads into an empty house to hole up for the evening. As the soldiers start arguing with one another, strange things begin happening in the house -- and everyone in the group soon realizes that the place is haunted. (Horror) - 2004

retroplex.us.title: Oklahoma Annie
retroplex.us.description: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day. (Western, Comedy) - 1952

retroplex.us.title: Prairie Badmen
retroplex.us.description: Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and his pal, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are riding west when they meet a traveling medicine show run by a doctor and his teenage son. Billy discovers that the doctor has a map showing the location of a stash of gold stolen from a local stagecoach company. While both Billy and the doctor favor returning the gold to its owners, the son wants to keep it for himself. When the teen runs off with the map and finds himself chased by outlaws, Billy rides out to save him. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: The Dawn Rider
retroplex.us.description: John Mason (John Wayne) suffers a cruel homecoming when he witnesses his father's murder as he rides into town. Incensed, he chases after the killers, but he suffers a gunshot wound that cuts his pursuit short. Alice Gordon (Marion Burns) sees to his injury, and Mason is taken by her kindness and beauty. But things turn sour when her beau, Ben (Reed Howes), becomes jealous. After Mason discovers the men who killed his father, his plan for a duel is sabotaged by Ben, who has been manipulated. (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: Susanna Pass
retroplex.us.description: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: The Desert Trail
retroplex.us.description: John Scott (John Wayne) is a rodeo rider, assisted by his buddy Kansas Charlie (Eddy Chandler). But while the duo is settling a debt with their promoter, Farnsworth (Henry Hall), thieves Pete (Al Ferguson) and Jim (Paul Fix) murder and rob Farnsworth and manage to pin the crimes on John and Charlie. The accused then flee, assume two new identities, take up with a shopkeeper named Anne (Mary Kornman) and set out to clear their names and bring the real killers to justice. (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: Man From Oklahoma
retroplex.us.description: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) and his partner (George "Gabby" Hayes) help a woman (Dale Evans) in distress. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: The Man From Utah
retroplex.us.description: One day, John Weston (John Wayne) helps stop a bank robbery. George Higgins (George Hayes), the town's grateful marshal, asks Weston for his help in solving another crime. It seems someone at a touring rodeo show is killing the top riders before they can take home the trophy -- and the prize money. Weston agrees to investigate and works his way into the show, which is run by the shady Spike Barton (Edward Peil). As Weston gets closer to the truth, he finds himself in even greater danger. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Rimfire
retroplex.us.description: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Range Beyond the Blue
retroplex.us.description: A stagecoach operator in the untamed territories of the American Southwest, Margie Rodgers (Helen Mowery) becomes a target for bandits when she starts hauling gold. Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), a pair of justice-minded cowboys, stumble across an attempt to rob one of Margie's coaches, and they save her loot from the villains. But, when it becomes clear that the attempted crime was part of a larger conspiracy, Eddie and Soapy must widen their investigation. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Oath of Vengeance
retroplex.us.description: Cowhands Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) open a general store together in a town embroiled in a battle between ranchers and farmers. Cattleman Dale Kirby (Mady Lawrence) believes the farmers have been stealing cattle, forcing him to borrow from crooked lender Steve Kinney (Jack Ingram). In truth, however, it is Kinney himself who is behind the cattle thefts. When Billy attempts to mediate, he and Fuzzy find themselves threatened by Kinney. (Western) - 1944

retroplex.us.title: Ambush Trail
retroplex.us.description: Curley Thompson (Bob Steele) clashes with Hatch Bolton (I. Stanford Jolley), who is buying out small ranches in order to sell to a large grain combine. Thompson is questioned by Deputy Walter Gordon (Kermit Maynard) when Gordon's brother, the sheriff, goes missing. While investigating this disappearance, Thompson is given a cryptic clue by rancher Joe Moore (Al Ferguson), but Moore is killed before he can elaborate. Thompson and Gordon must then join forces to find the truth. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Down Missouri Way
retroplex.us.description: In this musical, agriculture professor Jane Colwell (Martha O'Driscoll) is seeking a quiet getaway when she takes her prized mule off to visit an Ozarks farming community. But upon arrival she is stunned to discover a film crew diligently at work on a new movie. Soon, Jane and her mule companion are swept up in the filmmaking frenzy. While the photogenic mule upstages the production's human star (Renee Godfrey), Jane finds herself falling for the feature's dashing producer (William Wright). (Musical comedy) - 1946

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, op. 55
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Fabio Luisi leitet das Dänische Radio-Sinfonieorchester in einer Aufführung von Beethovens 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, Op. 55. Neben der fantastischen "Eroica" werden auch Strawinskis Psalmensinfonie und Strauss' "Don Juan" interpretiert. (Special, Entertainment, Music, Concert) - 2020-12-10

classica.us.title: Schumann - Violinkonzert und Sinfonie Nr. 1
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Christian Zacharias leitet das Orchestre National de Lille in einem Schumann-Konzert. Das Konzert beginnt mit der "Genoveva"-Ouvertüre, Op. 81, obwohl Schumanns einzige Oper Genoveva nicht oft aufgeführt wird. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-02-15

classica.us.title: Music in the Air
classica.us.description: Millionen Menschen sehen jedes Jahr die Live-Übertragung des Neujahrskonzerts. Als die Drei Tenöre anlässlich der Fußball-WM 1990 ihr legendäres Konzert in Rom gaben, sahen weltweit eine Milliarde Menschen an den Fernsehern zu. Die Dokumentation untersucht, welche Möglichkeiten das Fernsehen bietet, klassische Musik einem breiten Publikum näherzubringen. Was dachten Herbert von Karajan und Leonard Bernstein darüber, die als einige der ersten die Möglichkeiten dieses Mediums intensiv nutzten? (Documentary) - 2012

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Fidelio, Op. 72
classica.us.description: Fidelio, Op. 72, ist die einzige Oper von Ludwig van Beethoven. Die Verfilmung aus 2018 aus dem Schweizer Theater St. Gallen basiert auf der Bühneninszenierung von Jan Schmidt-Garre. Otto Tausk dirigiert das Orchester, den Chor und die Solisten. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-03-29

classica.us.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise für zwei Klaviere Op. 77
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags spielt Martha Argerich Saint-Saëns Polonaise für Klavier Op. 77. Das Konzert wurde im Château de Chantilly, Frankreich, aufgezeichnet. Die Pianistin wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet. (Special, Music) - 2025-06-01

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight

classica.us.title: Tschaikowski - 1. Klavierkonzert
classica.us.description: Ein buntes Weihnachtskonzert der Philharmonie zuidnederland mit Tschaikowskis berühmtem Klavierkonzert Nr. 1. Chefdirigent Dmitri Liss bringt gemeinsam mit Meisterpianist Boris Berezovsky sein russisches Blut in Wallung. (Special) - 2026-03-01

classica.us.title: Schostakowitsch - 24 Präludien und Fugen, Op. 87
classica.us.description: Der Pianist David Levy spielt die 24 Präludien und Fugen, Op. 87, von Dmitri Schostakowitsch. Der Komponist ließ sich dazu von Bachs "Wohltemperiertem Klavier" inspirieren. Das Konzert fand 2023 im Budapest Music Center statt. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-04-05

classica.us.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke Op. 73
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmet sich Martha Argerich dem Kammermusikrepertoire in diesem Konzert, das im Château de Chantilly, Frankreich, aufgenommen wurde. Die Pianistin wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2025-05-31

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Esa-Pekka Salonen
classica.us.description: Esa-Pekka Salonen probt mit dem Los Angeles Philharmoniker Claude Debussys Orchesterwerk "La mer". Probeaufnahmen wie diese liefern einen spannenden Einblick in Salonens akribische Arbeit und sein Verhältnis zu den Musikern und der Musik. (Music) - 2008-04-16

classica.us.title: Berg - Klaviersonate, op. 1
classica.us.description: Der italienische Pianist Andrea Molteni spielt Alban Bergs Klaviersonate in h-Moll, Op. 1. Molteni begann mit sechs Jahren mit dem Klavierspiel. Er schloss das Conservatorio di Musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como mit Auszeichnung und Ehrennennung ab. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-04-12

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Heavenly Voices - Farinellis Vermächtnis
classica.us.description: Als "Kastraten" werden männliche Sänger bezeichnet, die mit glockenklarer Stimme Tonhöhen des Soprans erreichen können, weil man sie noch vor dem Stimmbruch kastriert. Die Dokumentation beschäftigt sich mit dem Aufstieg bekannter Kastraten in der Geschichte und den Umständen, die ihre Karriere möglich machten. Außerdem sprechen die zwei Kontratenoren Max Emanuel Cencic und Philippe Jaroussky über die Musikentwicklung im Barock. (Documentary, Music) - 2012

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Streichquartett Nr. 6, Op. 18, Nr. 6
classica.us.description: Das Streichquartett Quatuor Ébène feierte Beethovens 250. Geburtstag mit der Gesamtaufführung aller 16 Streichquartette. Die Aufzeichnung aus der Pariser Philharmonie zeugt von der intensiven Auseinandersetzung des Ensembles mit Beethovens Werk. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-10-02

classica.us.title: Danielpour - Elegies
classica.us.description: Hartmut Haenchen leitet das Orchester der Philharmonie zuidnederland in einem Konzert von Richard Danielpours "Elegies". Solisten sind Marina Prudenskaya und Thomas Oliemans. Die Aufnahme entstand 2019 im Muziekgebouw Eindhoven in den Niederlanden. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-04-04

classica.us.title: Werke für Laute von J. S. Bach
classica.us.description: Der französische Lautenist Thomas Dunford spielt in diesem intimen Kammermusikkonzert, das 2017 im Concertgebouw Brügge aufgezeichnet wurde, verschiedene Werke für Laute von J. S. Bach. Auf dem Programm steht Suite für Laute in g-Moll. (Special, Music, Concert) - 2024-02-24

classica.us.title: Martinů - Concertino für Klaviertrio & orchester
classica.us.description: Das italienisch-schweizerische Ensemble Trio des Alpes und das Orchestra da Camera di Mantova tun sich zusammen in dieser Aufführung des Concertino für Klaviertrio und Streichorchester, H. 232, des tschechischen Komponisten Bohuslav Martinů. ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: Smugshot

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: Smugshot

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation
tinyhousenation.us.description: S01 E01 172 Sq. Ft. Dream Castle John and Zack have to design a 172 sq. foot space that includes a pink castle, full kitchen, and master bedroom with privacy.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation
tinyhousenation.us.description: S05 E04 No Fall Zone John and Zack head north to Coeur d'Alene, Idaho, where Army veteran Newt and his wife, Brooke, are building a tiny home on wheels with plans to travel the country after Newt completes his sixth and final deployment.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation
tinyhousenation.us.description: S03 E05 300 Sq. Ft. Surf Shack Chic Amber and Tommy are looking to build their first home, and they've decided going tiny is exactly the way they want to do it, keeping the beach theme of the surrounding Santa Barbara area in mind.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation
tinyhousenation.us.description: S02 E01 264 Sq. Ft. Honeymoon Suite A Little Rock couple builds a 264 sq. foot mobile honeymoon pad as they prepare to get married and hit the road as traveling nurses.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation
tinyhousenation.us.description: S05 E13 Tiny Digs for Racing Pigs John and Zack head to Arkansas farm country to help a couple who have been living on the road turn a school bus into a tiny home where they can settle down.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation
tinyhousenation.us.description: S02 E06 192 Sq. Ft. Bird House John and Zack must repurpose the material Simon and Lindsey have collected to create a tiny space big enough for them and their nine birds.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation
tinyhousenation.us.description: S03 E19 240 Sq. Ft. Tiny Ski Lodge Chris and Tamara absolutely love skiing and snowboarding and have asked John and Zack to help build them a modern ski lodge that has functional space to not only store all their gear, but also maintain it.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S03 E07 Tiny For a Family of Five in Temecula With three teenagers in the house, Joe and Sheri live a hectic life of sports, homework and family meals, but they'll be empty nesters soon, and it's motivating them to look tiny.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S03 E08 Tiny Urban Retreat in Seattle Eric and Anna are two Generation Y-ers in Seattle, Washington and they're ready to take the tiny plunge.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S03 E10 Tiny Urban Living in Boston Anthony and Angela miss the hustle and bustle of their overseas lives, and they hope to find the vibrant equivalent in the heart of Beantown.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S03 E11 Tiny Portland Home on Wheels A proud resident of the Pacific Northwest thinks he's got what it takes to live in 300 square feet or less, but doesn't want to bite off more tiny than he can chew.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S03 E12 Tiny Pasadena Starter Home Chris and Maggie are ready to try something they've never done before, live with each other.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S03 E13 Tiny San Diego Digs for Three Rachel and Josh are ready to put down some roots in sunny San Diego. They're focusing their search on San Diego's well known Craftsman Houses.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S03 E14 Tiny Home Hunt in Huntsville Eric and Cami own a home in Spokane, and are in the middle of building a dream life, but they need a second home in Huntsville.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S03 E15 Tiny House ABCS in the ATL Born and raised in Atlanta, Georgia, Addison's life recently entered completely new territory; motherhood. She's chosen now, while her baby boy is young, as the time to make the move from staying with family to finding her own tiny place.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S03 E16 Finding Texas Tiny That's Worth It - Fort Worth It Jared and Lindsay realized that too much house space was keeping them in debt and stressed out; they are committed to finding their very own tiny house.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S03 E17 Tiny Artist Digs in Philly Caitlin's plan is to downsize and consolidate her living space and studio space into a single tiny space, hoping to find something that's both practical and inspiring.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S03 E18 Tiny San Francisco Flat Hunt It's time for Gregorie and Christopher to buy their first home together. They're willing to trade space for a downtown location in an exciting neighborhood.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S03 E19 Big Travelers Need Tiny Home in Nashville Emily and Julian get the help of local real estate agent to find a tiny, mobile home that they can plunk in their backyard while they rent out their main house.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting

truehistory.us.title: Cities of the Ancient World - The Lure of the City
truehistory.us.description: Cities are integral to modern lives; why wandering ancient humans leave the forests and plains to create settlements; the fundamental question of "why" is the first step toward understanding the inhabitants and lessons from ancient cities. (World history) - 2014-08-29

truehistory.us.title: Cities of the Ancient World - Çatalhöyük - First Experiment in Urban Living
truehistory.us.description: Imagining a city with no streets, public buildings or common spaces; the world's first city offers an intriguing window into life in the Neolithic era; exploring the remains of Çatalhöyük's family housing, murals and religious shrines. (World history) - 2014-08-29

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - The Meaning of Evolution
truehistory.us.description: Pondering why Darwin is so revolutionary; his breakthrough is not in introducing the idea of evolution, which has long been debated, but in proposing how evolution occurs; surveying these and other themes that are developed in the course. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - The Way It Used to Be
truehistory.us.description: Examining the traditional worldview in the West, which is based on the biblical account of creation fixed at 4004 B.C.; an allied idea is the Great Chain of Being, pictured as an immutable scale of life forms from the most primitive to God himself. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400 - Self-Interest, Human Survival, and History
truehistory.us.description: Differences between economic history and a history of economics; the primary concerns of current economic historians; watershed economic moments of the last 500 years; why modern economic history begins around 1400. (World history) - 2016-08-28

truehistory.us.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400 - Marco Polo, China, and the Silk Road Trade
truehistory.us.description: Examining the state of the global economy circa 1400, when Europe was at the bottom of the economic success ladder; the broad economic outlines of China, India, and the Islamic world; how Europe laid groundwork for the new capitalist world system. (World history) - 2016-08-28

truehistory.us.title: America After the Cold War: The First 30 Years - 1990: America's New World Order
truehistory.us.description: The end of the Cold War is a key point in history; the rapid collapse of the Soviet Union; the fall of the Berlin Wall; delving into the American story in the early 1990s; conflicts in Kuwait and Bosnia test America's new role in a post-Soviet world. (History, Educational) - 2020-02-28

truehistory.us.title: America After the Cold War: The First 30 Years - The Clintons and the 1990s
truehistory.us.description: Bill Clinton's presidency dominates the domestic news in the 1990s. From his dramatic showdown with Newt Gingrich and the Republican Congress's Contract with America, this is a presidency of high drama; surveying the tumultuous decade. (History, Educational) - 2020-02-28

truehistory.us.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City - Reflections On and of Pompeii
truehistory.us.description: When most people hear the name of the archeological site of Pompeii, they think of destruction; gaining an overview of the course; considering why the remains of Pompeii offer more than just a story of a cataclysm. (Educational, Ancient history, History) - 2010-09-03

truehistory.us.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City - Geology and Geography On the Bay of Naples
truehistory.us.description: Land and humankind help to shape Pompeii; examining the violent geological forces that forge the distinctive region of the Bay of Naples; tracing its influence on the surrounding geography; the various cultures that contribute to life in this area. (Educational, Ancient history, History) - 2010-09-03

truehistory.us.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era - 1865: \"Bind Up the Nation's Wounds\"
truehistory.us.description: The key historical forces that characterize the Gilded Age and the Progressive Era; the competing ideals that define these eras; the US in 1865; the extraordinary social, political and economic changes unleashed by the devastation of the Civil War. (American history) - 2015-05-01

truehistory.us.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era - The Reconstruction Revolution
truehistory.us.description: The Reconstruction era following the Civil War; governmental policies and legislation enacted to safeguard the welfare of former slaves and average citizens; these policies are progressively dismantled, the South comes under the rule of the whites. (American history) - 2015-05-01

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Three Peoples Collide
truehistory.us.description: Neither the Eurocentric term 'discovery' nor the blandly neutral 'encounters' do justice to the impact of Europeans, Africans and Native Americans coming together in the New World; a collision whose causes and effects are outlined in this lecture. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - The Native Americans
truehistory.us.description: Most of the inhabitants of the Americas arrive in migratory waves from Asia between 40,000 and 2,000 B.C.; their civilizations are based on sophisticated irrigation and farming; complex religions and social structures; rivaling those of Europe. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - History on a Geological Scale
truehistory.us.description: Taking a virtual walk from the Washington Monument to the U.S. Capitol to explore the 4.54 billion-year history of Earth, with each stride representing 1 to 2 million years; along the way, fossils paint a picture of life on Earth from its start. (Science) - 2016-11-11

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - Life Cast in Ancient Stone
truehistory.us.description: Learning about those whose curiosity about the Earth and its fossils leads to the development of the science of paleontology; studying the geographic, climatic and chemical requirements for a living organism to leave behind its fossilized record. (Science) - 2016-11-11
